description: This file defines a PHP class 'LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping' which extends Symfony's ParameterBag. It manages LDAP employee attribute mappings, provides methods for conversion to array, extracting attribute values from LDAP entries, and creating instances from an array of mappings. It includes logic for validation of mapping fields and generating search filter parameters based on LDAP directory entries.

classes.name: LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping
classes.description: Represents LDAP employee attribute mappings with validation and conversion capabilities, extending Symfony's ParameterBag.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all stored attribute mappings as an array.

methods.name: getAllAttributeNames
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute names from the stored mappings.

methods.name: extractAttributeValuesToSearchFilterParam
methods.description: Extracts LDAP entry attribute values to populate LDAPEmployeeSearchFilterParams based on current mappings.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an instance of LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping from an array of field-attribute mappings with validation.
